function.name: EvernoteManagerSearchNotes
function.description: Search for notes by keywords, tags, or notebook ID.

keywords.description: A list of keywords to search for in the note title or content (optional).

tags.description: A list of tags to search for in the note tags (optional).

notebook_id.description: The unique identifier of the notebook to search within (optional).

max_results.description: The maximum number of results to return (optional, default: 10).

function.description: Provides personalized health recommendations based on the user's genetic data.

function.name: GmailSendEmail
function.description: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

to.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

cc.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

bcc.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

send_at.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

attachments.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.
